home.title: AI ATLAS — Documented capabilities, quotas, and the limits of each subscription level
home.desc: A reference database documenting the capabilities of each AI tool, its operational quotas in figures, and the scope of entitlements available at every subscription level, with manually audited pricing.
home.heroB: A technical dossier for every AI tool.
home.lead: A reference database that documents each tool's capabilities, measures its operational quotas in figures, and delimits the entitlements available at every subscription level. Pricing is entered and audited manually, paired with a declared verification date.
home.featuredLead: Each dossier documents capabilities, quotas, and exclusion criteria, and closes with an explicit recommendation.
home.howLead: Three criteria that narrow the field before any price comparison.
home.how1b: Category derives from the form of the final artefact — image, text, audio, or code — not from a product name or its market share.
home.how2t: Measure quotas rather than read headlines
home.how2b: Phrases such as "expanded usage" carry no measurable value. The operative references are the consumption ceiling, concurrency limits, and unit price on overage.
home.how3b: Output ownership, the scope of commercial use, and whether data feeds training — clauses to review before subscribing, not after.

facts.title: Material provisions before subscribing
facts.lead: Derived programmatically from the tier data presented on this page, not editorially written.
facts.noFree: No free tier is available — a paid subscription is a condition of operation.
facts.hasFree: A free tier is available and sufficient for assessment before subscribing.
facts.publicOutput: Output is publicly visible on lower tiers; concealing it is a paid entitlement.
facts.trainsOnData: Usage data feeds model training on certain tiers.
facts.noTraining: Usage data does not feed training on paid tiers.
facts.noApi: No API is available — integration within an independent product is not possible.
facts.hasApi: An API is available and supports integration within an independent product.
facts.commercialOk: Commercial use is authorised on paid tiers.
facts.commercialNo: Commercial use is not guaranteed — the terms require review.
facts.noArabicUi: The interface does not support Arabic.
facts.unverified: Pricing is provisional and its reference audit is incomplete.
facts.adminRoute: Provisioning is available through Atlas with local payment.
fit.title: Matching quotas against usage volume

fit.whyCapacity: Quota of {cap} only — short of the specified consumption by {gap}
fit.noneTitle: No tier satisfies the specified constraints
fit.noneDesc: Relax one constraint, or enquire about a bespoke arrangement through Atlas.
fit.note: The calculation is indicative and based on the quotas declared on this page and their verification date.
